caseName: Mountain States Telephone & Telegraph Co. v. District Court, City & County of Denver
caseNameFull: Mountain States Telephone & Telegraph Co., dba Mountain Bell v. District Court, City and County of Denver, Colorado

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Colo. Motions of Chevron Corp. and Edison Electric Institute et al. for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Certiorari denied. Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions and this petition.
